items.name: the mei reset facial (recovery + restoration)
items.description:
a boutique 90-minute restorative facial designed for skin that feels irritated, stressed, or easily reactive. 

the mei reset combines a spa experience with results reflecting the approach of skin clinics in Japan and South Korea, using the same medical-grade Korean formulations alongside advanced skin technologies.

this customized treatment focuses on soothing visible irritation, supporting barrier repair, and improving overall comfort and balance in the skin. Each session is composed to help reduce redness, increase moisture retention, and refine texture and tone.

your treatment may include ultrasonic skin scrubber extractions, eye/face RF lifting, plasma + high-frequency for collagen-building, and multi-modal circulation support, paired with professional-grade products from Dr. esthé, Éclat du teint, and Dermabell.

the result is calmer, clearer skin with enhanced barrier function, and a replenished complexion.

items.name: microneedling
items.description: collagen induction therapy for fine lines, acne scarring, and overall skin density. numbing, a precise pen depth, and gentle aftercare.

items.name: the mei glow facial (refinement + radiance)
items.description:
a boutique 60-minute Korean facial tailored to enhance tone, refine texture, and promote a smooth, radiant complexion. 

the mei glow is customized for clients seeking brighter, clearer, and more even skin with a polished, natural finish.

this service focuses on complexion refinement and visible clarity. medical-grade Korean formulations are combined with gentle device work and sculpting massage to support circulation, encourage healthy skin function, and enhance brightness.

your treatment includes a double cleanse ritual, a custom light peel for uneven texture, micro-current hydration infusion, lymphatic sculpting massage for the face, neck, and décolletage, layered masking, and a tailored selection of finishing essences, serums, and creams chosen to support your skin goals.

the result is hydrated, radiant, bouncy skin with improved tone, smoother texture, and a refined, healthy glow.

services.footnote: full menu including brow shaping, lash tinting, and body services available on request. members receive priority booking and pricing.

aboutMei.title: meet brrrriannnna
aboutMei.lede: skin care, for me, started with my own. a long stretch of trial and error, a handful of mentors, and the slow realization that the work i wanted to do wasn't in a chain spa — it was in a small room, with one person, taking the time. joean was here
aboutMei.body: i trained in clinical aesthetics in vancouver and spent six years on treatment-room floors at studios across the city before opening mei skin. i still see every visit the same way: it's an hour for you, and the only job is to leave your skin (and you) a little more at home in itself. philip was here
aboutMei.pull_quote: i won't sell you something you don't need. if your skin's doing well, i'll tell you to come back in eight weeks, not six.

atmosphere.title: an hour that's *actually* yours.
atmosphere.body: no rotating staff, no shared waiting room, no other faces in the building during your treatment. just one practitioner, one room, and the time to do the work properly.

items.name: amberly
items.quote: Brianna is a highly skilled medical-grade facial aesthetician. Her Korean facial treatments drastically improved my skin texture and helped heal my skin barrier. With your needs and specifications in mind, she tailors her treatment to your skin. items.name: natalie

I got the Mei Glow Facial at Mei Skin and it was honestly the best facial in Vancouver. The studio is so cute and calming and feels like a boutique facial studio. I felt relaxed the whole time.

Brianna is really sweet and knows so much about skincare. She customized everything for my skin and used Korean medical-grade skincare like Dr. Esthé. My skin looked so glowy and hydrated after. If you want glowing, radiant skin, I totally recommend Mei Skin. This is definitely my new go-to facial studio in Vancouver.

items.q: what should i expect on my first visit?
items.a: we start with a careful skin reading — under good light, with no clock running. i ask about your routine, your history, and what brought you in. the treatment is chosen for what i see, not a pre-set menu. you'll leave with a written plan and a small kit of samples if desired.

items.q: how long are appointments, and how often should i come?
items.a:
most mei skin appointments are 60–90+ minutes, depending on your treatment and skin goals. your first visit may be slightly longer to allow time for a personalized consultation and skin assessment.or best results, we typically recommend treatments every 4–6 weeks, which aligns with your skin’s natural renewal cycle. however, the ideal frequency depends on your skin concerns, lifestyle, and goals. some clients visit monthly for ongoing maintenance and glow, while others come seasonally or before special events.

during your appointment, we'll create a customized treatment plan and recommend a schedule that works for your skin and your lifestyle.
yes we have retail products from dermabell, éclat du teint, dr.esthé, and more available to purchase on-site.

items.q: i have sensitive or reactive skin. is this for me?
items.a:
absolutely. mei skin specializes in a thoughtful, skin-first approach that prioritizes barrier health, comfort, and long-term skin wellness. every treatment is customized to your skin's needs on the day of your appointment.

if you have sensitive, reactive, redness-prone, or easily irritated skin, we'll carefully select products and techniques that support your skin without overwhelming it. we focus on strengthening and nourishing the skin barrier rather than aggressive treatments that can lead to irritation.

before every facial, we'll discuss your skin history, sensitivities, allergies, and current skincare routine to ensure your treatment is both safe and effective.

our goal is for your skin to leave feeling calm, balanced, and healthy—not stripped, inflamed, or overworked.

items.q: can i bring products i'm already using?
items.a: please. bring everything — including the things you're embarrassed about. we go through it together and figure out what stays, what goes, and what's missing. no judgment, ever.

privacy.title: privacy *policy.*
privacy.intro:
mei skin studio runs this website. this page explains what happens to your information when you visit it.

the short version: this site collects very little, we don't sell anything to anyone, and there are no advertising trackers here.

sections.heading: information collection and use
sections.body:
**what you give us.** this website doesn't have a booking system or a working contact form. enquiries reach us by email or instagram, not through this site.

the newsletter sign-up on the home page is not connected yet — anything typed into it stays in your browser and is never sent to us or stored anywhere.

when you do email or message us, we keep that correspondence so we can reply, book you in, and remember your skin history between visits.

**what's collected automatically.** basic technical information about your visit:

- which pages you looked at, and for how long
- the site or search that sent you here
- your rough region — city or country level, never a precise address
- browser and device type

we look at this in aggregate to understand which parts of the site are useful. it isn't used to build a profile of you.

sections.heading: cookies and local storage
sections.body:
this site sets no advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

the one thing stored in your browser is a small flag remembering that you entered the preview password, so you aren't asked for it on every page. it lives on your device, is never sent to us, and clearing your browsing data removes it.

sections.heading: third-party services
sections.body:
two services are involved in serving this site:

- **vercel** — hosts the website and provides its visitor analytics. the analytics are cookie-free and don't follow you to other sites.
- **google fonts** — serves the typefaces used here. as part of loading them, your ip address is visible to google.

we don't run advertising pixels, and nothing about your visit is shared with advertisers.

sections.heading: your choices and rights
sections.body:
under british columbia's personal information protection act and canada's PIPEDA, you can ask us what personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it.

email us and we'll respond within 30 days. there's no charge for a reasonable request.

sections.heading: security
sections.body:
we take reasonable measures to protect the information we hold, and we keep as little of it as possible — the less that exists, the less there is to lose.

that said, no method of transmitting information over the internet is completely secure, and we can't guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: changes to this privacy policy
sections.body: if this policy changes, the updated version will appear on this page with a new date at the top. material changes will be flagged on the site.

terms.title:
terms &
*conditions.*
terms.intro: these terms cover the use of this website and the services provided at mei skin studio. booking an appointment or using this site means you agree to them.

sections.heading: booking and appointments
sections.body:
appointments are requested by email or instagram and confirmed by us directly. a time isn't held until you've had a confirmation back.

- **cancelling or rescheduling.** 24 hours' notice keeps your full credit. inside 24 hours, 50% of the booked service is charged. one room, one appointment per slot — a late cancel means an empty room.
- **running late.** we'll do what we can, but a late start may mean a shortened treatment so the next guest isn't pushed back.
- **no-shows.** a missed appointment without notice is charged in full.

sections.heading: treatments and results
sections.body:
the services offered here are esthetic skin treatments. they are not medical care, and nothing said in the studio or on this site is a diagnosis or medical advice. if something on your skin concerns you, please see a physician or dermatologist.

before your first visit, tell us about:

- skin conditions, allergies, or recent reactions
- medications and actives you're using — retinoids, acids, accutane in particular
- recent treatments, injectables, or procedures
- pregnancy or breastfeeding

some treatments aren't appropriate in these situations, and a few are unsafe. we may patch test, modify, or decline a treatment when it's the safer call — that judgment is part of the service, not an inconvenience.

skin is individual. results vary between people and between visits, and no particular outcome is guaranteed.

sections.heading: pricing and payment
sections.body:
the prices on the menu are the prices you pay. there are no add-ons applied at the desk.

payment is due at the time of your appointment. prices may change over time; the price quoted when you book is the price honoured for that visit.

sections.heading: gift cards
sections.body:
gift cards are available in any amount, delivered electronically or as a printed card. they don't expire.

they aren't refundable and can't be exchanged for cash.

sections.heading: website content
sections.body:
the writing, photographs, and design on this site belong to mei skin studio. please don't republish or reuse them without asking first.

we try to keep everything here accurate and current, but the site is provided as-is.

sections.heading: privacy
sections.body: how your information is handled is set out separately in our privacy policy.

sections.heading: changes to these terms
sections.body: these terms may be updated from time to time. the current version always lives on this page, with its date at the top.
